summary.text: Katie Rose is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
Lisa Cathro (D) and Becky Dunmire (Constitution Party) are also on the ballot for the open seat.
